title: region RAM overflowed
compiler_output:
arm-none-eabi-ld: build/app.elf section `.bss' will not fit in region `RAM'
arm-none-eabi-ld: region `RAM' overflowed by 6312 bytes
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status

reference_context.title: STM32F103x8/xB Datasheet (ST)
reference_context.snippet: STM32F103x8: 64 Kbytes of Flash memory and 20 Kbytes of SRAM.

expected.root_cause: The 24 KB static log_buf in .bss alone exceeds the 20 KB of SRAM on the STM32F103C8.
expected.fix: Shrink LOG_BUF_SIZE (e.g. 4096) or move constant data to flash.
